compiled_state.description:
## Observation (read-only, 2026-11-12 ~05:55 PST)
The spend-cap Lambda (`/aws/lambda/bedrock-spend-cap` log, ticks from 13:41Z onward) reported the metered (ceiling-priced CloudWatch token) estimate at about 3 times the Cost Explorer figure for the same UTC day, with `effective_source=metered`. The metered arm crossed the daily threshold and attached `BedrockDailySpendCapDeny` (about 05:40 PST), denying `bedrock:InvokeModel` to every capped role, including rebar-gerrit-instance-role, until the 00:00 UTC release.

infra/terraform/bedrock-spend-cap/README.md documents the metered arm as an intentional upper bound, running at about 1.1 to 1.9 times settled billing. A ratio of about 3 is outside that band. Dollar figures are deliberately omitted (public tracker); they are in the Lambda log lines and Cost Explorer for 2026-11-12.

## Hypotheses (unproven)
- The model mix shifted (5.5 inference profiles since change 3340) so more tokens are priced at a ceiling well above their real rate.
- Cost Explorer lags intra-day, so a same-day comparison overstates the ratio relative to the settled-day figure the README describes.
- Cache-read tokens are priced at a ceiling far above the actual cache-read rate.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The ratio for 2026-11-12 is re-measured against the SETTLED Cost Explorer day, and the cause of any excess over the documented band is identified from the per-direction token counts.
- [ ] Either the ceiling table is corrected or the README band is updated with the measured reason; no config key, env var or flag.
compiled_state.title: Bedrock spend-cap metered estimate ran about 3x settled billing on 2026-11-12, above the README's documented band
